player_prompt.intro:
I yɛ Mastermind.
I bɛ o donni kɔnɔ ye {code_length} tariku ye, kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna 1 ka taa {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
O tɛ weele, i bɛ o kɛnɛɛ o kɔnɔ o tɛ '[2 1 4 5]'.
O kɛnɛɛ kɛrɛɛna, i bɛ o donni feedback kɛrɛɛna bɛɛ kɛɛrɛ aur fini kɛɛrɛ.
Bɛɛ kɛɛrɛ ye kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna o tɛ kɛrɛɛna, wɛlɛ fini kɛɛrɛ ye kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna o tɛ kɛrɛɛna.
I bɛ {max_turns} tɔn o donni kɔnɔ.
player_prompt.with_repeats: a be se ka kɛ ko u y'a to koo dɔ kɛra tugun.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: n'a ma kɛ siɲɛ fila ye

invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: A man ɲi ka tɛmɛ nimɔrɔ fila kan.

outcome.win: I tuuni kɔnɔ, o kɛ {black_pegs} kɔnɔ o tɛ {code_length} kɛɛrɛ wɛrɛwɛ.
outcome.turn_limit: Wakati bɛɛ bɔra. I ka gɛlɛn {percent} pɔsɛnti ye ɲɛfɛnw cɛma.
